description: Local time, timezone, a 14-day calendar with day names and Today/Tomorrow labels, sunrise, sunset and solar times, and moon phase and rise and set for a place. Use it to reason about dates, times or daylight there ("when is sunset?", "is it dark there now?"); when current_time.timezone_resolved is false, state times in UTC. Example: {"location": "Seattle, WA"}.

location.description: Space: one place (place text, ZIP or `lat,lon`). EDR position; `nearest` on a feature product (non-empty).
